messages:
mei: heads-up — noticed a stability regression in the AWQ canary for llama-13b-awq-v2 when act-quant=enabled and group_size=64. p95 latency spikes and ~0.6% drop on MMLU subset in the canary dataset :eyes:
rajesh: ugh. when did the canary start rolling? any recent changes to kernels or batching?
lucas: can reproduce locally on staging with the same config. timeline: steady until ~8000 steps, then intermittent token-generation stalls (~200-400ms extra) on long-context samples. sample logs: `decode_step 1345: kv_cache miss? retry`
mei: canary rolled 2 hours ago — rollout bot: `eva deployed llama-13b-awq-v2:rev-3 -> canary (10%)`
eva (deploy-bot): deploy metadata: image=redwood/serve:2026-11-02, runtime=awq-v3.0, canary=10%, watchers=eng-ml. No autoscale events recorded.
sam: do we have comparison against GPTQ/int8 baseline for same prompts? accuracy delta of 0.6% — is that within expected AWQ variance?
chen: baseline gptq-8bit pinned on same hardware shows 0.0% delta for those MMLU samples. AWQ act-quant change is the prime suspect. Also seeing more OOM retries in logs.
rajesh: quick config snippet?
lucas: posting simplified serve config we used:
```
model: llama-13b-awq-v2
quant: awq
act_quant: true
group_size: 64
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  prefer_latency: true
cache:
  prefix: enabled
```
mei: test matrix we ran: group_size {32,64,96}, act_quant {true,false}, and GPTQ-8 baseline. instability only triggers when act_quant=true AND group_size>=64. group_size=32 looks stable.
sam: hypothesis: larger groups increase activation dynamic range, act-quant's per-group scaling introduces edge-case saturation on long contexts, causing KV-cache mismatches and backpressure.
rajesh: can we reproduce with a smaller synthetic workload quickly? lucas, can you run a focused loop with long context (4k tokens) and pinned seed?
lucas: running now, I'll push logs to /tmp/awq_stability_run_182345. initial run shows p95 latency +120ms, token error traces: `quant_recons_error > 1e-2` at some steps.
mei: acceptance criteria for canary rollback: any sustained p95 > baseline by 100ms for >10 minutes OR any consistent accuracy regression >0.3% on the canary eval slice.
chen: propose immediate mitigations: 1) set act_quant=false for canary 2) cap group_size to 32 for AWQ variants 3) enable extra KV-cache integrity checks in runtime. which do we prefer?
sam: I vote for #1 + #2 as quick rollback, then run ablation with #3 enabled.
rajesh: schedule: revert canary to act_quant=false now, scale to 0, redeploy 10% with group_size=32. I can run the change in the next 5 mins.
lucas: re-run ablation with finer granularity: group_size {16,24,32,48} and act_quant true/false. want to capture both latency and MMLU delta plus token-level quant error.
mei: please attach the small eval harness (100 prompts) and include per-prompt accuracy deltas. Also log GPU kernel fallback counts.
rajesh: command I'll run to change canary: `rdw deploy set-config --model llama-13b-awq-v2 --canary 10 --set act_quant=false --set group_size=32`
eva (deploy-bot): canary update requested by rajesh. starting rollout.
lucas: test run 1/6 complete. preliminary: group_size=48 + act_quant=true => transient stalls persist. group_size=32 + act_quant=true => stable but MMLU -0.2% compared to baseline. Looks like act_quant introduces a small accuracy hit even at 32.
mei: note: -0.2% may be acceptable for some customers if latency wins are significant. need biz/metrics review.
sam: also measure throughput: group_size=32 + act_quant=true yields +8% tokens/sec vs gptq baseline; group_size=64 had +18% but with instability. tradeoff.
rajesh: next steps: 1) complete ablation matrix by EOD 2) run 1h canary with act_quant=false & group_size=32 for safety 3) if ablation shows acceptable operating point (e.g., group_size=32 + act_quant=true with <=0.25% acc drop and stable), we can incrementally raise canary to 30% and watch.
mei: I'll prepare a short note for product about accuracy/latency tradeoffs, include exact numbers and suggested defaults: default for AWQ on llama-13b => group_size=32, act_quant=false; graceful opt-in to act_quant with telemetry.
lucas: leaving logs at /tmp/awq_stability_run_182345/*.gz and a quick csv of per-prompt deltas at /tmp/awq_ablation_182345.csv
chen: I'll add runtime assert that fails fast if `quant_recons_error > 5e-3` during decode and emits metric `awq_quant_recon_error` so we can alert early.
mei: thanks all. tagging @sam for follow-up on perf tradeoffs and @product for the note. will check back after 1h canary. :thumbsup:
